00111100_00000010_00010010_00110100   // lui $2, 0x1234        // ($2 = 0x12340000)
00110100_01000011_01010110_01111000   // ori $3, $2, 0x5678   // ($3 = 0x12345678)
00111100_00000100_00010001_00100010   // lui $4, 0x1122        // ($4 = 0x11220000)
00110100_10000101_00110011_01000100   // ori $5, $4, 0x3344   // ($5 = 0x11223344)

00000000_01000011_00111000_00100100   // and $7, $2, $3        // ($7 = 0x12340000)
00000000_01000011_01000000_00100111   // nor $8, $2, $3         // ($8 = ~(0x12340000 | 0x12345678) = 0xEDCBA987)
00100000_00001001_00000000_00000001   // addi $9, $0, 0x0001  // ($9 = 0x00000001)
00000000_01000101_01010000_00101011   // sltu $10, $2, $5        // ($10 = ($2 < $5) ? 1 : 0 = 0)
00000000_00000010_01011000_01000010   // srl $11, $2, 0x0001   // ($11 = $2 >> 1 = 0x091A0000)

10100100_00000011_00000000_00001100   // sh $3, 12($0)       // (Mem[12] = 0x5678)
10000000_00001100_00000000_00001100   // lb $12, 12($0)      // ($12 = 0x78) - 하위 바이트

00010100_01000011_00000000_00000001   // bne $2, $3, +1          // ($2 != $3 -> 분기 -> 다음 줄 건너뜀)
00100000_00001101_00000000_00000001   // addi $13, $0, 0x0001 // (실행 안됨)
00100000_00001101_00000000_00110001   // addi $13, $0, 0x31    // ($13 = 0x00000031)

00000100_01100001_00000000_00000001   // bgez $3, +1             // ($3 >= 0 -> 분기 -> 다음 줄 건너뜀)
00100000_00001110_00000000_00110101   // addi $14, $0, 0x0035 // (실행 안됨)
00100000_00001110_00000000_01100011   // addi $14, $0, 0x0063 // ($14 = 0x00000063)

00000001_10000000_11111000_00001001   // jalr $31, $12     // ($31 = return addr, jump to 0x78)
